body_markdown:
BLOOMFIELD, Conn.


, Sept. 9, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Global health company The Cigna Group (NYSE: CI) will host its Investor Day on Wednesday, September 30, 2026.


The event will begin at 8:30 a.m. ET, featuring in-depth presentations on corporate strategy and financial targets. A live webcast of the presentation will be available at[https://investors.thecignagroup.com/events-and-presentations/default.aspx](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4769353-1&h=2161644636&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.thecignagroup.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&a=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.thecignagroup.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx) in the Investor Relations section of The Cigna Group's website.


To listen to this presentation live on the internet, visit[https://investors.thecignagroup.com/events-and-presentations/default.aspx](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4769353-1&h=2161644636&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.thecignagroup.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&a=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.thecignagroup.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx) at least 15 minutes prior to the presentation to download and install any necessary audio software.


**About The Cigna Group**


The Cigna Group (NYSE: CI) is a global health company committed to creating a better future built on the vitality of every individual and every community. We relentlessly challenge ourselves to partner and innovate solutions for better health. The Cigna Group includes products and services marketed under Cigna Healthcare, Evernorth Health Services or its subsidiaries. The Cigna Group maintains sales capabilities in more than 30 markets and jurisdictions, and has over 180 million customer relationships around the world. Learn more at[thecignagroup.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4769353-1&h=101996189&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.thecignagroup.com%2F&a=thecignagroup.com) .
